featureRows.title: Grease lets go faster than you expect.
featureRows.body: Burnt-on food and cold oil are the two things most washes struggle with. Aqua Spark's formula breaks the bond between grease and steel almost as soon as it touches — pans that usually sit soaking wipe clean the first pass.

featureRows.title: A little drop covers a full sink.
featureRows.body: Because the formula isn't watered down, you use less per wash than you're used to. A 250ml bottle of Aqua Spark quietly outlasts a bigger bottle of something thinner.

featureRows.title: Tough on oil, easy on your hands.
featureRows.body: No harsh degreasers doing the heavy lifting — just a citrus-based formula that can be part of your daily wash without leaving hands dry and tight afterward.

usageSteps.title: Add a few drops
usageSteps.body: Straight onto your sponge, or into a sink of warm water — a little goes further than you'd think.

usageSteps.title: Work it over the grease
usageSteps.body: No pre-soak needed. The foam lifts oil and burnt-on food as you scrub.

usageSteps.title: Rinse and you're done
usageSteps.body: Dishes come out squeaky clean, and the sink smells like fresh lemon, not chemicals.
